offerte.title: PDF offers

home.passiTitolo: Up and running in three steps

registra.title: Register the company
registra.text: The CRM starts with phases, activity types, sources and loss reasons ready to use.

configura.title: Configure
configura.text: Products, tags and visibility rules: each sales rep sees their own customers.

vendi.title: Sell
vendi.text: From the first contact to the accepted offer, with pipeline and reports always up to date.

home.chiusuraTitolo: No more deals lost in emails
home.chiusuraTesto: Register your company and try the CRM with your sales team.

features.sottotitolo: Everything you need to follow customers and deals, from the first contact to the offer.

clienti.title: Customers and contacts
clienti.text: Single company registry with sales status, owner, source, tags and contact persons.

lead.title: Leads
lead.text: Not yet qualified contacts, converted into a customer with one click together with the opportunity.

pipeline.title: Opportunities and pipeline
pipeline.text: Value, probability and expected close; the history of every phase change.

agenda.title: Activity agenda
agenda.text: Today, overdue and upcoming: calls, emails, meetings, with the outcome recorded.

promemoria.title: Reminders
promemoria.text: A pop-up notice before each activity, with the button to open it.

offerte.title: Offers
offerte.text: Numbering per year, price-list products, PDF with your terms and sending by email.

note.title: Notes and attachments
note.text: Pinned notes and files on customers, opportunities and offers.

visibilita.title: Sales rep visibility
visibilita.text: Each sales rep sees their own customers, or everyone sees everything: the company decides.

report.title: Reports
report.text: Pipeline by phase and owner, won and lost by reason, lead conversion, activities per user.

riassegna.title: Reassignment
riassegna.text: When a sales rep leaves, their customers and deals move to a colleague in one go.

export.title: Excel export
export.text: The customer list with the chosen filters, ready in Excel.

gdpr.title: Privacy consent
gdpr.text: Consent to marketing communications with its date, on customers and leads.

integrato.title: Integrated
integrato.text: The same customers as attendance and document management, without duplicate registries.

pricing.sottotitolo: You pay for the users of the CRM: all features are always included.

prova.descrizione: To try it with your sales team.

studio.descrizione: For sales networks and multiple companies.

pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. No commitment: cancel whenever you want.

installare.domanda: Do I need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No: the CRM is used from the browser of your computer or smartphone.

visibilita.domanda: Does every sales rep see all customers?
visibilita.risposta: The company decides: only their own customers (default) or all of them; administrators always see everything.

presenze.domanda: Can I use it together with attendance management?
presenze.risposta: Yes: customers and contacts are the same in all active applications.

dati.risposta: Yes: the customer list exports to Excel and offers to PDF.

about.sottotitolo: We have worked for years alongside small and medium businesses and their sales teams.
about.paragrafo1: We know the work of those who sell: contacts scattered across emails and phones, offers to redo, deals that get lost.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} puts this work in order: every customer has its card, every deal its phase and every offer its PDF.

semplice.title: Simple for sales reps
semplice.text: Logging a call or a meeting takes a few seconds.

ordinato.title: Orderly for managers
ordinato.text: Everyone's pipeline, results and activities always at hand.

vicino.title: Close to businesses
vicino.text: Designed with people who sell every day, not for large corporations.

register.sottotitolo: Create your company's account and start following customers and deals.
register.condizioni: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy
register.inviata: We sent you an email with the link to activate the account: open it to complete the registration.
register.esito: Your company is ready. These are the users created: log in with the password you chose.

crm.title: CRM manual
crm.description: Customers, leads, pipeline and opportunities, agenda and reminders, PDF offers, notes and attachments, reports; for administrators visibility, tables, settings and reassignment.
